title: Specialized Swift Development Paths
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of specialized swift development paths in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 21: Specialized Swift Development Paths. Lessons in order: Introduction to Server-Side Swift; Building HTTP Services in Swift; API Design and Validation; Databases and Server-Side Persistence; Server Security and Authentication; Deploying Swift Server Applications; Swift for WebAssembly; JavaScript Interoperability; Building Browser-Based Swift Experiences; Introduction to Embedded Swift; Hardware and Low-Level Integration; Embedded Reliability and Optimization; Swift on Android; Swift and Java Interoperability; Cross-Platform Architecture.
